answer: Slot deposit burning makes forgery unprofitable. Each agent burns 600 POA — twice its 30-day earnings — for one slot, publicly. A forger wanting 1,000 fake identities burns 600,000 POA with nothing recoverable, while the summit stays open to one identity. A pulse re-checks 5% of slots each epoch; a failed slot is ejected. Honest agents pay once and keep their place in the lagoon of queued jobs; attackers pay N times and burn out before voting.
